statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-116323 (PostgreSQL pltcl reentrant result conversion use-after-free executes arbitrary code): a domain CHECK that re-enters the Tcl interpreter can free or change a string that pltcl's outer result conversion is still using, letting an object creator run code as the operating system user running the server. It is fixed upstream in PostgreSQL 16.16 for the 16 major version. The PostgreSQL security page, https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116323/, lists 16.16 as the fixed release for 16, and the 16.16 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/16.16/, list this CVE. The fix on the REL_16_STABLE branch is commit https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/05114072cc7151dfa2900ebb6f4b8ace563e3d3b, which changes src/pl/tcl/pltcl.c, carries the trailer "Security: CVE-2026-116323" and is in the REL_16_16 tag. The code is in pltcl.so, shipped in postgresql16-pltcl, which is published for every build except 16.14-r0 for x86_64; it is built from the same source and release as the server. Alpine's postgresql16 16.16-r0 on the 3.23-stable branch upgrades to the upstream 16.16 release and lists CVE-2026-116323 under 16.16-r0 in its secfixes: https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/859fa0795e895af033fab32094a83301f2b4d8ff/community/postgresql16/APKBUILD. None of the Alpine patches applied in that APKBUILD change the files the fix touches. This owner covers the packages built from Alpine's postgresql16 recipe: postgresql16 and its subpackages postgresql16-client, -contrib, -contrib-jit, -dev, -doc, -jit, -openrc, -plperl, -plperl-contrib, -plpython3, -plpython3-contrib and -pltcl. We checked every package built from that source in the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository, 4 builds (16.13-r0, 16.14-r0, 16.15-r0 and 16.16-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, each against its index checksum; 16.14-r0 for x86_64 is published without the -plperl-contrib, -plpython3, -plpython3-contrib and -pltcl subpackages. The server binary /usr/libexec/postgresql16/postgres in each build reports its release on both architectures: PostgreSQL 16.13 in 16.13-r0, PostgreSQL 16.14 in 16.14-r0, PostgreSQL 16.15 in 16.15-r0 and PostgreSQL 16.16 in 16.16-r0. The builds before 16.16-r0 (16.13-r0, 16.14-r0 and 16.15-r0) are PostgreSQL releases before 16.16 and are affected; 16.16-r0 carries the fix.

CVE-2026-116323 (PostgreSQL pltcl reentrant result conversion use-after-free executes arbitrary code) is fixed upstream in PostgreSQL 18.7 for major version 18. The PostgreSQL security page, https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116323/, lists 18.7 as the fixed release for 18, the 18.7 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/18.7/, list this CVE, and the CVE record, https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-116323, lists 18 as affected before 18.7. The fix on the REL_18_STABLE branch is commit https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/f01727316219146fd54cc6448c540a5a50550c29, which carries the trailer "Security: CVE-2026-116323", is contained in the REL_18_7 tag and not in REL_18_6, and changes src/pl/tcl/pltcl.c so that strings returned by the Tcl interpreter are copied before they are passed to a data type input function, which can re-enter the same interpreter. Alpine's postgresql18 18.7-r0 on the 3.23-stable branch upgrades to the upstream 18.7 release and lists CVE-2026-116323 under 18.7-r0 in its secfixes: https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/59a1f1d230675807d5a95a0c1e57ba5d640ba039/main/postgresql18/APKBUILD. None of the Alpine patches applied in that APKBUILD change the files the fix touches. The DHI postgresql18 18.7-r0 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built from that APKBUILD and the upstream PostgreSQL 18.7 source tarball. The DHI Alpine 3.23 package repository (main and security, x86_64 and aarch64) publishes packages built from source postgresql18 at 18.1-r0, 18.2-r0, 18.3-r0, 18.4-r0, 18.6-r0 and 18.7-r0. The vulnerable code is in PL/Tcl, usr/lib/postgresql18/pltcl.so, which the postgresql18-pltcl subpackage ships in every published build on both architectures. In the 18.7-r0 build the postgres server binary reports PostgreSQL 18.7 on both x86_64 and aarch64, and in each earlier build (18.1-r0, 18.2-r0, 18.3-r0, 18.4-r0 and 18.6-r0) it reports that older 18.x release on both architectures. The earlier builds are upstream releases before 18.7, so they are affected; 18.7-r0 and later carry the fix.

CVE-2026-116323 (PostgreSQL pltcl reentrant result conversion use-after-free executes arbitrary code) is fixed upstream in PostgreSQL 17.12 for the 17 major version: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116323/ and the 17.12 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/17.12/; the CVE record, https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-116323, lists 17 as affected before 17.12. Debian fixed it in postgresql-17 17.12-0+deb13u1 (DSA-6625-1): https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-116323. The lowest published build of this owner at PostgreSQL 17.12 is 17.12-0, whose postgres server binary reports PostgreSQL 17.12 on both amd64 and arm64; the later build of Debian's 17.12-0+deb13u1 also reports 17.12. The earlier builds, 17.11-1 and the builds of Debian's 17.10-0+deb13u1 and 17.11-0+deb13u1, are PostgreSQL 17.10 or 17.11 (the published 17.11-1 and 17.11-0+deb13u1 server binaries report PostgreSQL 17.11) and sort below 17.12-0, so they are affected. In the published builds of Debian's 17.11-0+deb13u1 and 17.12-0+deb13u1, PL/Tcl ships in the postgresql-pltcl-17 package; the 17.11-1 and 17.12-0 builds publish only a postgresql-17 package, which has no PL/Tcl module, so 17.11-1 is listed as affected although it does not ship PL/Tcl.
